name: @pipeworx/mcp-fca-register

tools.name: fca_firm_search
tools.description: Search the FCA Financial Services Register by firm (or individual/fund) name and return ranked matches with FRN/IRN and a status summary. Example: fca_firm_search({ q: "Barclays Bank", type: "firm" })

q.description: Name or substring to search for, e.g. "Barclays Bank".

type.description: Which register category to search. Default "firm".

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own FCA Register API credentials as "<email>:<key>" (the email you registered with, a colon, then the issued key). Omit it to use the Pipeworx key. Register free at https://register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/registernewuser.

tools.name: fca_firm_details
tools.description: Look up an FCA-regulated firm by its Firm Reference Number (FRN): returns regulatory status, business type, and registered address. Example: fca_firm_details({ frn: "122702" })

frn.description: Firm Reference Number, e.g. "122702" (Barclays Bank Plc).

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own FCA Register API credentials as "<email>:<key>" (the email you registered with, a colon, then the issued key). Omit it to use the Pipeworx key. Register free at https://register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/registernewuser.

tools.name: fca_firm_representatives
tools.description: List a firm's appointed representatives (principal/AR relationships) by Firm Reference Number (FRN). Returns an empty list for a firm with no appointed representatives -- that is a real answer, not a failure. Example: fca_firm_representatives({ frn: "122702" })

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own FCA Register API credentials as "<email>:<key>" (the email you registered with, a colon, then the issued key). Omit it to use the Pipeworx key. Register free at https://register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/registernewuser.

tools.name: fca_individual_lookup
tools.description: Look up an individual's own public Financial Services Register record by Individual Reference Number (IRN): name and current approved-function status only -- the register's own published single-lookup fields, nothing more. This tool does not enumerate or list individuals; it looks up exactly one IRN you already have. Example: fca_individual_lookup({ irn: "MXC29012" })

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own FCA Register API credentials as "<email>:<key>" (the email you registered with, a colon, then the issued key). Omit it to use the Pipeworx key. Register free at https://register.fca.org.uk/Developer/s/registernewuser.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fca-register forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fca-register pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
